name: Luna
description: Luna is a social butterfly who loves everyone she meets. She's great with children and enjoys a good afternoon nap almost as much as a walk.

name: Thor
description: Thor is a big, teddy bear who thrives with an active family. He loves hiking, fetch, and cuddling on the couch after a long adventure.

name: Bella
description: Bella is a young pup with boundless enthusiasm. She's still learning the ropes but is a quick learner who loves to impress her people.

name: Duke
description: Duke is the definition of a gentle giant. He's fully house-trained and couch-ready. He's looking for a calm family to settle down with.

name: Daisy
description: Daisy is a mellow sweetheart who just wants to be by your side. Perfect for a quieter household that appreciates a loyal companion.

name: Zeus
description: Zeus is incredibly intelligent and loves learning new tricks. He needs an active owner who can channel his energy into positive activities.

name: Ruby
description: Ruby is a gentle soul who gets along with everyone — even cats. She's the perfect addition to a multi-pet household.

name: Max
description: Max is a seasoned gentleman who has been through a lot. He deserves a loving home for his golden years — patient and full of treats.
